dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How long have you been standing there...

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: You trying to get me to abandon my post? Surely you don't think I'm falling for that!

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Loyal Luke never abandons his post! I must keep watch over the— Ahem! Diplomatic mission!

dialogues.speaker: Luke
dialogues.text: Ahem... Almost let it slip there... Anyway, no loitering for unauthorized persons, so get outta here!
